analysis: source patient/date integrity, inpatient observation opportunity, and temporal validation
primary_temporal_split: earliest 70% within each centre by SurgeryDate; same-day records kept together
secondary_temporal_split: calendar cutoff 2022-01-01; centre composition changes across the cutoff
date_quality_sensitivity: within-centre 70/30 models refitted after excluding invalid admission-surgery-discharge chronology
bootstrap: 1000 patient resamples within validation centre, conditional on locked temporal predictions
inference_boundaries: Temporal validation reuses participating centres and is not independent external validation.
AdmissionDate is complete and DischargeDate is missing once, but 23 records have invalid date order.
PostopHospitalDays is an inpatient observation-opportunity proxy, not proof of complete 0-168 h ascertainment.
The fixed 2022 split mixes temporal change with changing centre composition.
